ai-evals-bot: nightly-eval alert: model=rwd-model-v2.3-q4_0 suite=instr-follow-100 status=FAIL pass_rate_drop=12% (91->79) severity=P2 job=nightly-eval/2026-03-19-23:01 commit=abc1234
Noah C: Oof. Which promptsets are driving the drop?
ai-evals-bot: top failing buckets: persona-switch, followup-clarity, few-shot-chain. example failures attached.
Emily R: looking at the examples now. early glance suggests short inconsistent completions — more generic "I don't know" outputs in q4 variant.
Jordan H: this started showing up right after the quant4 PR landed, commit abc1234 is the quant kernels merge. Could be quantization regression.
Taylor L: can we rule out tokenization mismatch first? any diffs in tokenizer version between runs?
Sam K: tokenizer.yaml shows same version, but model artefact changed size. I can repro locally with the nightly bundle in docker.
Emily R: sample failing excerpt:
```
FAIL: promptset=persona-switch idx=42
gold="I usually help with billing questions. I can look that up for you."
pred_q4="I don't know. Sorry."
logprob_gold=-1.2 logprob_pred=-7.8
notes: answer truncated after 12 tokens, missing persona marker
```
Noah C: that logprob gap is suspicious — could be KV cache precision or attention kernel difference. Also seeing more low-confidence tokens at turn starts.
Taylor L: i'll run a float32 baseline on the same commit to confirm it's the quant path. will also run q8_0 and q4_1 variants for comparison.
Jordan H: assign owners: Emily primary for triage + root-cause, Noah secondary for eval infra checks, Taylor for repro and quant experiments. Sam on-call if we need infra.
Emily R: adding initial hypothesis list: 1) quant kernel weight scaling bug 2) attention mask rounding 3) promptset shuffling change in eval harness (unlikely)
Sam K: infra note: nightly cluster had one GPU preempt in the job window (alert id gke-preempt-331). but job retried — logs don't show OOM. tagging SRE if we need deeper node trace.
Noah C: severity P2 ok. Let's start with quick sanity runs: (a) run same prompts on rwd-model-v2.3 (non-quant) at commit abc1234 (b) run q4_0 at prev-good commit 81d2ef to isolate whether regression is in quant change or elsewhere.
Emily R: scheduled short triage call in 15m in #eng-ml-quick. I'll post a gsheet with failing prompt IDs and sample tokens.
Taylor L: ping me there, i'll bring repro artifacts. :mag:
ai-evals-bot: linked artifacts: https://internal.evals/redwood/nightly/1817550012 and logs: https://internal.logs/redwood/abc1234/nightly-eval
Emily R: action items: (1) Noah run non-quant baseline (2) Taylor run q4/q8 variants prev-good commit (3) Sam confirm infra clean (4) Emily collate failing prompt IDs and open issue if reproducible. owners set.
Noah C: started baseline run now, ETA ~8m.
Taylor L: starting quant comparisons, will post results in thread.
Sam K: infra looks OK from node side, but keeping watch.
Emily R: thanks team. marking this P2 and blocking any auto-rollout of q4_0 for production until we have root cause. :no_entry:
Noah C: update: baseline non-quant pass_rate=90.8 (close to expected).
Taylor L: update: q8_0 pass_rate=89.5, q4_0 repro pass_rate=78.9 — consistent with alert. attaching diff of token probabilities.
Emily R: good repro. opening issue rwd-infra/issue-512 with labels [regression][quant][high-priority] and assigning to Jordan for kernel triage.
Jordan H: acknowledged, will start kernel bisect.
Sam K: will keep the cluster pinned for further runs.
Emily R: next steps posted in issue, will reconvene if we see conflicting signals. thanks! :white_check_mark:
